title: GenWave Theme Manifest
description: The <slug>.theme.json shape a GenWave station loads (app repo SPEC F103.2, ARCHITECTURE "Theme system", GenWave.Host.Theming.ThemeManifest/ThemeManifestParser). Mirrors persona-card.schema.json's posture exactly: additionalProperties is true throughout, and this schema pins TYPES ONLY — it never rejects a byte-valid manifest over a field it doesn't yet know about, an unrecognized token name, or a token/font-descriptor value shape. The app's own ThemeManifestParser is the real validator (CSS-safe family/src/weight/style regexes, hex-colour token values, light/dark token-set membership PARITY, and — separately, T158/T180 — the AA contrast gate); this schema only catches gross shape errors (wrong type, missing key) so a malformed catalog submission fails fast in CI rather than only at app load. Never-reject-byte-valid: a manifest this schema accepts is not guaranteed to load in the app (that needs the CSS-safety regexes and parity/contrast checks this schema deliberately leaves to the app and to T180's own lint), but a manifest the app can actually load and render must never be rejected here for a reason the app itself doesn't enforce.

slug.description: Stable theme identifier (ThemeManifest.Slug). The catalog's own directory-name/slug rules (tools/validate.py) are enforced separately from this format schema, the same split persona-card.schema.json draws for its own `name`.

name.description: Display name shown wherever a station lists its installed themes (ThemeManifest.Name).

author.description: Who created this theme (ThemeManifest.Author). Same field whether GenWave shipped it or an owner authored it — no field marks authorship (ThemeManifest's own remarks).

fonts.description: Both font roles are mandatory (ThemeFonts) — a theme with only one declared face is rejected at app load.

modes.description: Both modes are mandatory (ThemeModes) — a flat one-look theme is rejected at app load because it regresses automatic prefers-color-scheme dark.

fontFace.description: One font role (ThemeFontFace) — a family name plus the vendored assets that back it. The app rejects an empty assets list at load; this schema pins the array type only, not a minItems bound, so it never rejects a byte-valid document for a rule the app itself enforces at a different layer.

family.description: Font-family name. The app additionally requires a conservative CSS-safe shape (ThemeManifestParser.FontFamilyPattern) since this interpolates into same-origin CSS — that character-set check is the app's job (and T180's contrast/shape lint), not this schema's.

fontAsset.description: One vendored font file (ThemeFontAsset). The app additionally constrains src to a vendored /fonts/*.woff2 path and weight/style to a CSS-safe descriptor shape (ThemeManifestParser) — this schema pins types only.

tokenMap.description: Semantic token name -> CSS colour value (ThemeModes.Light/Dark). Deliberately permissive on which keys are present and on value shape beyond "a string" — the app's own load-time checks own the CSS-safe token-name shape, the hex-colour token-value shape, and light/dark membership PARITY (ThemeManifestParser), and the fixed 19-name vocabulary + AA contrast are T158/T180's data-driven gate, not this format schema's. A non-string token value is still a gross shape error worth catching here.
